title: Spectral Gap for the Binary Fixed-Margin Swap Chain
summary: We prove an explicit spectral-gap lower bound for the lazy swap chain on binary matrices with prescribed row and column sums. This chain is a standard sampler for fixed-margin null models in ecology, statistics, and network analysis. Kannan, Tetali, and Vempala (KTV) conjectured that it mixes rapidly for all feasible margins \citep{kannan1997simple}. We show that for every feasible set of margins on an $m\times n$ binary matrix, the lazy swap chain has spectral gap at least $$\binom{m}{2}^{-1}\binom{n}{2}^{-1}.$$ The bound is tight in the worst case.
